sourceName: American Battlefield Trust and National Park Service

battles.name: Great Bridge
battles.note: Virginia militia stop a British advance near Norfolk.

battles.name: Yorktown
battles.note: The siege ends major fighting in the Revolutionary War.

battles.name: First Manassas
battles.note: The first large battle of the war is fought at Bull Run.

battles.name: Ball's Bluff
battles.note: Union troops are driven down the bluff into the Potomac.

battles.name: Hampton Roads
battles.note: Ironclads fight in the harbor that guards Norfolk.

battles.name: Second Manassas
battles.note: A second battle returns to the same Bull Run ground.

battles.name: Ox Hill / Chantilly
battles.note: A short fight in Fairfax covers the Union move toward Washington.

battles.name: Fredericksburg
battles.note: Union assaults fail against the heights above the Rappahannock.

battles.name: Chancellorsville
battles.note: Lee divides his army in the woods west of Fredericksburg.

battles.name: Brandy Station
battles.note: The largest cavalry battle in North America is fought here.

battles.name: Bristoe Station
battles.note: A railroad fight in Prince William cuts a Confederate advance.

battles.name: The Wilderness
battles.note: Grant and Lee meet in dense woods south of the Rapidan.

battles.name: Spotsylvania
battles.note: Fighting lasts for days along the Mule Shoe line.

battles.name: Cold Harbor
battles.note: A costly Union assault occurs east of Richmond.

battles.name: Petersburg
battles.note: The long siege begins against the rail lines into Richmond.

battles.name: Five Forks
battles.note: The last rail line west of Petersburg is cut.

battles.name: Appomattox Court House
battles.note: Lee surrenders the Army of Northern Virginia.
